segments.title: How many Americans TRAVEL for Thanksgiving?
segments.say: How many Americans travel for Thanksgiving this year? Comment your answer. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: 81.5 MILLION!
segments.say: Eighty-one and a half million! That's AAA's forecast, starting today.

segments.title: About 9 in 10 DRIVE
segments.say: And about nine in ten of them drive. Seventy-two point nine million by car.

segments.title: First DIP in 3 years
segments.say: It's a hair below last year, ending a three-year record streak.
Comment your answer, then follow for Guess It number 22 tomorrow.
